page.notes: The page is very faded and blurred, with strong show-through from the reverse. Almost all the verse lines and body text are illegible; only isolated words are partly readable, and none of these readings can be trusted. The drop caps C and H are inferred from their shape. The page number and catchword are uncertain. The line counts in the brackets are estimates. Only the chapter headings are clear enough to read.
